title: NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide) supplements as an anti aging and treatment for hair loss? - Hair Loss; Anti-aging - HairSite - Hair Restoration Forum
abstract:
Hottest new trend in nutraceuticals as an anti-aging and possibly treatment for hair loss?  
*“Our bodies produce NMN and the molecule is found in produce we eat, such as like broccoli, cabbage, avocado, and cucumbers. Shin-ichiro Imai, MD, PhD, professor of developmental biology at Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis, is a leader on NMN research. The focus of his lab is basic mechanisms of aging and longevity. His mouse-based research indicates NMN can possibly slow signs of aging, boost energy, and rejuvenate metabolism in humans. But when it comes to supplements on the market, Imai advised caution.”*  
Study to evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of NMN as an Anti-ageing Supplement in Middle Aged and Older (40-65 Years) Adults.
